title: Prime-torsion devissage
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and let $F$ be a torsion sheaf in $\Ab(X_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. For each positive integer $n$, write $F[n]=\ker(n:F\to F)$ [def-pur-abelian-sheaf-kernel]. Then, in the filtered colimit sense [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit],
$F=\varinjlim_{(\mathbf N_{>0},\mid)}F[n]$; for $m\mid n$ the inclusion $F[m]\subseteq F[n]$ is monic, and if $n=\prod_i\ell_i^{e_i}$ with $n>1$, repeated use of

$$
0\longrightarrow F[\ell_i]\longrightarrow F[n]
\xrightarrow{\ell_i}\ell_iF[n]\longrightarrow0,
$$

in which $F[\ell_i]$ is killed by $\ell_i$ and $\ell_iF[n]$ is killed by $n/\ell_i$ (that is, $\ell_iF[n]\subseteq F[n/\ell_i]$), reduces assertions about $F[n]$ to assertions about sheaves killed by one prime.

proof.text: For the divisibility-ordered positive integers, the canonical inclusions of the kernels $F[m]$ into $F[n]$ are monomorphisms whenever $m\mid n$, and the filtered colimit of these subsheaves is $F$ by [lemma-weil-pbc-torsion-filtered-union].

If $n=\prod_i\ell_i^{e_i}>1$ with the $\ell_i$ prime, apply [lem-weil-pbc-prime-factor-devissage] with $r=\ell_i$ to the sheaf $F[n]$, which is killed by $n$: it gives the short exact sequence $0\to F[n][\ell_i]\to F[n]\xrightarrow{\ell_i}\ell_iF[n]\to0$ with kernel killed by $\ell_i$ and image killed by $n/\ell_i$, so $\ell_iF[n]\subseteq F[n/\ell_i]$. Since $\ell_i\mid n$, a local section killed by $\ell_i$ is killed by $n$, so $F[n][\ell_i]=F[\ell_i]$.

Any assertion about torsion sheaves that is stable under short exact sequences can therefore be proved for $F[n]$ by induction on the total number of prime factors of $n$, reducing to the cases of sheaves killed by one prime via [lemma-weil-pbc-prime-factor-induction].
